from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Represents one paper in the collection with its outgoing reference relationships."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the paper")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers (known from the collection context) that this paper cites or references")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates the citation information for all provided papers."""
    papers: list[Paper]
